decisions.reason: The accelerator program has been prominently featured on the home page since 2023, signaling a public commitment that management will likely continue to justify the resources already invested.

Although the bitumen binder has only a dedicated page rather than home-page prominence, two years of investment and public presentation create escalation pressures that favor keeping it, albeit slightly less strongly than for home-page products.

The decontamination plant's repeated home-page promotion and explicit launch narrative create strong sunk-cost and justification pressures, making it highly unlikely management would drop it within the coming year.
